Connect Forgejo to CircleCI. Needs Forgejo 16 or later.

✓ Connected Forgejo at https://forgejo.example.com for acme

Add the webhook in Forgejo. Pipelines won't start without it.
  Open the acme organization's Settings → Webhooks → Add webhook → Forgejo:
    https://forgejo.example.com/org/acme/settings/hooks
  Target URL:
    https://internal.circleci.com/private/soc/forgejo/webhook/conn-forgejo-1
  Secret: paste the secret shown below
  Trigger on: Custom events…
    Repository events → Push
    Pull request events → Modification, Synchronized
  Then select Add webhook. To check it, push a commit and look under Recent Deliveries.

Secret (save this — it will not be shown again):
whsec-shown-once
